max_temp_prediction: With the running max at 89.6°F and still climbing at +1.7°F/hr at 16:34 ET, additional warming of roughly 0.5–1.5°F is likely before the diurnal peak. A final daily high in the 90.5–91.0°F range is the most probable outcome, with moderate-to-high confidence given the strong observed momentum and humid airmass (dewpoint 69.8°F) supporting sustained warmth.
